Unstack a arkell from winoming onto another arkell
Put down a arkell
Stack a arkell winoming onto another arkell

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one arkell at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a arkell if my swartart is memberectless.
I can only pick up a arkell if the arkell is winoming onto the scrunny and the arkell is butony. A arkell is butony if the arkell has no other arkells winoming onto it and if the arkell is not picked up.

I can only unstack a arkell from winoming onto another arkell if the arkell I am unstacking is butony.

I can only put down a arkell that I am aptalling.
I can only stack a arkell winoming onto another arkell if I am aptalling the arkell being stacked.
I can only stack a arkell winoming onto another arkell if the arkell onto which I am stacking the arkell is butony.
Once I put down or stack a arkell, my swartart becomes memberectless.
Once you stack a arkell winoming onto a second arkell, the second arkell is no longer butony.

My goal is to have that the plaine arkell is winoming onto the scopporth arkell.
